verdict.rationale: Official SDKs are a fair question for an online company-incorporation service, since comparable incorporation platforms can expose programmatic access. However, the evidence pack documents only a human, browser-based flow: Cartão de Cidadão or Chave Móvel Digital authentication, form-generated pacts, digital signing, and payment. It contains no mention of any SDK, API, or developer tooling, so the axis applies but has no supporting evidence.
